notes.title: ◎Report on Update ver 1.0.4(2025/06/09)
notes.notes:
◎Report on Update ver 1.0.4(2025/06/09)

------------------------------------

●Game Strategy  

・Lengthened the judgment of the upward insertion attack to diagonally upward direction.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621179/3e29df1f42491dfa89704033ce46b697b7a63d87.png"]


・Fixed the onset of the attack judgment one frame earlier.

・Fixed the onset of the forward insertion attack itself one frame earlier. 

・Fixed the problem with passing through walls to avoid getting stuck. 

・Fixed the problem with some English sentences being written in Japanese.

・Adjusted a part of the MAP related to the ladder-climbing action. 



●Subquests  

・Corresponding to missing texture of holomen.


・Other minor adjustments.

------------------------------------

We will continue to move forward so that you can enjoy “Star Soraight Fantasy: Magic to reach the sky”

 in the future as well.

Thank you for your continued support!✨

notes.title: ◎Report on Update (2025/06/02　ver 1.0.3)
notes.notes:
◎Report on Update ver 1.0.3(2025/06/02)
------------------------------------
●Game Strategy  
・Colors for “switches” and “moving floors” have been adjusted to make switch on/off states easier to identify.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621179/ec33191100b921f0d453f4b8e70009389837cb9f.png

・Added a tutorial on how to shoot darts at an angle by using the up/down and diagonal dart buttons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621179/09154a4c998b1aab5a48970ab924220c09ecf8a8.png
・Added a foothold to return to the waterfall area, previously only accessible via return or 0 HP without an item.  
・Fixed the UI display to remain visible when A-chan’s special skills are activated.  
・Boss item drops are now guaranteed to land in reachable locations, resolving cases where they couldn’t be picked up.  
・Skills previously unable to damage the final boss now deal damage, catering to players who wish to use those skills.

●Subquests  
・Purchasing the maximum number of “Sorasaurus” now unlocks a “Sorasaurus standing up” appearance.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621179/1eeaca9383e56c38b90c41713c17f4597d43910a.gif
・Cameras in stages unlockable with items will now also capture “stuffed toys” in photos.
------------------------------------
We will continue to move forward so that you can enjoy “Star Soraight Fantasy: Magic to reach the sky”
 in the future as well.
Thank you for your continued support!🌟
